systemic: a keyframe without from/to takes the span of its Cliopatria shape, and the union of keyframes alive lets a wide shape swallow a narrower explicit one (qing-dynasty_1673 here). The same overlap, small, remains in bijapur-sultanate_1670/_1675 (63 cells), kingdom-of-france_1673/_1674 (41), nayaks-of-madurai_1572/_1673 (29); not patched.
